bioelectric.reason: Only cell-physiology descriptors, carried by any paper measuring them and silent on cancer therapy, so they resemble the mechanism's vocabulary without containing the therapeutic claim. Absent under both arms; pool thin and confounded.

cold-atmospheric-plasma.reason: 'Plasma Gases' (D058626) EXISTS and carries 474 census records with 9 ferroptosis intersections, so the earlier 'no descriptor (n~2)' note here was wrong -- see analysis/atlas-thesis-rank.md. It is still not used for recall: D058626 sits under Inorganic Chemicals > Gases as a SUBSTANCE, its scope note spans surface modification, decontamination, dentistry and argon plasma coagulation, and ~23% of its records are not cold atmospheric plasma. Unmeasurable here for BREADTH, which is a different reason from absence.

cuproptosis.reason: No cuproptosis MeSH descriptor exists -- absent under both arms of the whole-vocabulary scan -- but 'Copper' (D003300) does and carries 6,526 census records, which CONTAINS the copper-ionophore literature while meaning the element. Over-broad rather than absent, and the earlier note quoting 'n~6' was a frozen-corpus figure.

disulfidptosis.reason: 'Disulfidptosis' (D000098560) EXISTS and carries 99 census records (2 in 2024, 87 in 2025, 10 in 2026), so a census volume count IS available and the earlier note's 'n=1' was a 4,830-record FROZEN-CORPUS figure carried as a reason a census-scale measurement is impossible -- this project's own 213-fold non-uniform-capture caveat, unapplied to its own unmeasurability verdict. Still unusable as a RECALL reference: the descriptor's own string trips the mechanism's keywords, so agreement would be near-tautological.

electrolysis.reason: 'Electrolysis' (D004572) EXISTS and carries 85 census records, against the ~19 the earlier frozen-corpus note measured. Bucket-confounded as a recall reference -- most of its frozen-corpus pool also carries 'Electrochemotherapy', which the tagger buckets as electrochemical-therapy (a taxonomy-boundary artifact, not a recall miss) -- and leaky besides, since the descriptor name is the keyword.

frequency-therapy.reason: NOT MeSH-measurable as of #MECH-PRECISION. "Radiofrequency Ablation" was the reference descriptor, but the mechanism is defined in the manuscript as "frequency therapy (including pulsed electromagnetic fields)" -- non-thermal field modulation -- while radiofrequency ablation is THERMAL tissue destruction, a physically different modality. The keyword list has been narrowed accordingly, so the descriptor no longer belongs to this mechanism and can no longer serve as its reference label. Broad "Electromagnetic Fields"/"Magnetic Field Therapy" remain excluded as context descriptors, so this mechanism now has no discriminative leaf and is reported NOT-MeSH-measurable rather than as zero recall. The thermal-ablation literature this tag used to absorb needs its own mechanism; until it exists, that literature is a documented coverage gap.

radioligand-therapy.reason: 'Radiopharmaceuticals' (D019275) contains the mechanism and carries 31,784 census records, so it over-counts by orders of magnitude; 'Radioimmunotherapy' is antibody-specific and bleeds to immunotherapy/ADC. No descriptor names radioligand therapy itself under either arm. Scaffold.

targeted-protein-degradation.reason: 'Proteolysis Targeting Chimera' (D000094243) EXISTS and carries 241 census records (2022-2026, 49 as major topic, including one Phase III, one Phase I and one randomised trial), so this mechanism's census volume and trial share ARE measurable and the earlier note reading 'no PROTAC descriptor; tiny pool (n~11)' was false against the census it sits beside -- the same defect analysis/atlas-thesis-rank.md recorded for cold atmospheric plasma, and not an expiry, since the descriptor has carried census records since 2022. The broad housekeeping 'Proteolysis' (5,288 records) contains it. Still unusable as a RECALL reference: the leaf's own string is the keyword.

ttfields.reason: No TTFields-specific MeSH descriptor, and none that contains it: an alternating intermediate-frequency field disrupting mitosis is not therapeutic electrostimulation, so `Electric Stimulation Therapy` (945 census records) resembles it rather than covering it, and a count of that descriptor would be a count of something else. Confirmed absent under both arms of the whole-vocabulary scan. ~38% of its tagger-positives also have empty MeSH.
